# `passportsim input`

Press a button, hold power, or plug the USB cable.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_input` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/input` |
| Scenario step | `press` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim input <button> [action] [--duration <DURATION>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--reset-kind <RESET_KIND>] [--then-run <THEN_RUN>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `<action>` | `"click"` \| `"double_click"` \| `"hold"` \| `"press"` \| `"release"` \| `"open"` \| `"close"` \| `"plug"` \| `"unplug"` | no | What to do with it (click). |
| `button` | `<button>` | `"up"` \| `"down"` \| `"ok"` \| `"power"` \| `"reset"` \| `"usb"` | yes | What to press. |
| `duration` | `--duration <DURATION>` | `union` | no | Press length. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `reset_kind` | `--reset-kind <RESET_KIND>` | `"chip"` \| `"usb_rts"` | no | Reset kind (chip). |
| `then_run` | `--then-run <THEN_RUN>` | `union` | no | Run after release. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/input.input.json`](../schema/commands/input.input.json).

## Examples

### Click the DOWN button and let the firmware react

```sh
passportsim input --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "action": "click",
  "button": "down"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "action": "click",
  "button": "down"
}
'@ | passportsim input --json -
```

### Hold the power button long enough to switch the rail

```sh
passportsim input --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "action": "hold",
  "button": "power"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "action": "hold",
  "button": "power"
}
'@ | passportsim input --json -
```

### Open the host side of the USB Serial/JTAG console

```sh
passportsim input --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "action": "open",
  "button": "usb"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "action": "open",
  "button": "usb"
}
'@ | passportsim input --json -
```

### Leave the cable in with no client reading, the U2 case

```sh
passportsim input --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "action": "close",
  "button": "usb"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "action": "close",
  "button": "usb"
}
'@ | passportsim input --json -
```
